entities.summary: Meja Anna Pernilla Kullersten is a Swedish composer, artist and singer. Among her best known songs are "Happy", "Private Emotion", a duet with Ricky Martin from his multi-Platinum album Ricky Martin (1999), and "All 'Bout the Money", which was nominated for a Swedish Grammy Award in 1998.
